Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Site Survey and Demonstration: The bidder shall carry out the site survey on any one day during the period from the 8th to the 10th day from the date of publication of the bid, in coordination with the designa ted representative of the unit. The bidder shall also demonstrate the functionality of one sample speaker, conforming to the prescr ibed technical specifications, on an existing pole for testing and verification by the unit. Submission of the duly signed and stamped Site Survey Certificate along with the bid is mandatory, failing which the bid shall be liable for rejection. Contact Details: E-mail: wcsr.project@gov.in 2.
